en.title: Choose k Points to Maximize the Minimum Gap
en.description:
From n distinct points on the x axis, choose k so that the minimum distance between any two chosen points is as large as possible, and output that maximum value.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains the coordinates. 2≤n≤100000, 0≤coordinate≤10^9 with all coordinates distinct, 2≤k≤n.
hints: After sorting, binary search on the candidate distance; greedily start from the leftmost point and each time choose the earliest point at least that distance from the last chosen point, then check whether k points can be chosen.
